title: Object shot down over Alaska said to have reassembled itself

tellings.quote: I heard things like it had reassembled itself and been seen flying over Canada.

plain: An object shot down over Alaska in 2023 is said to have put itself back together and then been seen flying over Canada. Michels mentions it in an episode with a NASA whistleblower, as something he heard: "I heard things like it had reassembled itself and been seen flying over Canada." He names no source, and if it were true, it would mean the object was not something ordinary that could simply be knocked out of the sky.
